brief: A PR bot decides whether a pull request needs the security team as a reviewer. Rule: security review is required when any changed file path starts with services/auth/ or packages/crypto/, or when the description indicates the change alters permissions, authentication, token or session handling, or secret handling. Otherwise normal review. Documentation-only changes and descriptions that merely mention these topics without changing them do not require security review.
input_shape: { title: string, description: string, files: string[] }
